name: Dumbbell Alternating Shoulder Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell beside each shoulder with palms facing forward.
Brace your core and keep your forearms vertical beneath the dumbbells.
Press one dumbbell straight overhead until your elbow extends while keeping the other at shoulder height.
Lower the raised dumbbell under control back to your shoulder and alternate arms.
tips: Keep your belt line level without leaning sideways or arching your lower back.
Keep your wrists straight and avoid using leg drive to push the weight up.
